use_case.description: One sentence: what a person uses this harness for, in their words, not the README's slogan.

domains.description: The kinds of work it is built for, most central first (1-4).

languages.description: Programming languages it is meant to write or edit, lower-case (python, rust, go, java, javascript, typescript, cpp, sql, ...). Empty if it does not write code.

not_for.description: Kinds of task it is plainly not meant for, if any.

evidence.description: The files or README lines this is based on, in one or two sentences.
